definition: Training on curated prompt-response pairs with the standard next-token loss (usually masked to the response).
details: Training on curated prompt-response pairs with the standard next-token loss (usually masked to the response). The first post-training stage: it teaches format, style, and instruction following, and is also how task-specific behavior (structured extraction, house tone, tool syntax) is installed.

explainer.lead: Training a model on curated prompt-response pairs with the standard next-token loss, usually masked to the response. It matters as the first post-training stage, teaching format, style and instruction following.

tiers.eli5: Showing a trained model lots of example questions with the answers you want, so it learns to reply in the right style and format.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers use it to install task-specific behavior such as structured extraction, house tone and tool syntax; the pitfall is that narrow or low-quality pairs can overfit style while degrading general capability.
tiers.paperLevel: Optimization minimizes next-token loss over prompt-response pairs, with the loss typically masked to response tokens; as the first post-training stage it shapes format and instruction following.

explainer.example: Fine-tuning on pairs of a prompt and a JSON output teaches the model to return structured extraction in the required schema.
